children: Thailand's benchmark stock exchange SET said on Friday that it signed an agreement with the New York Stock Exchange to establish a framework for dual listing and develop products and indexes.

This is the latest in a growing series of global tie-ups, following collaborations between Hong Kong's bourse operator and Bursa Malaysia, and between the New York Stock Exchange and Seoul's exchange operator.
